description: A deep reading of the Stargate as a story-generating device: addresses, one-way travel, the iris, and the unintended journeys of Solitudes, A Matter of Time, 1969 and 2010.

related_resources.reason: The core material-transit, radio and travel exception rules.
Early episode inconsistencies and the iris/security logic.
Antarctic second gate and Carter’s stream-diversion hypothesis.
SG-10 and black-hole-linked effects at the SGC.
Retrospective analysis of malfunctions and the shaped-charge solution.
Solar-flare travel and the encounter with young Hammond.
Aschen future and note carried through a timed wormhole.
Ernest Littlefield and the stranded early gate expedition.
